title: Standardize error message prefixes across whois() and status()
description:
Error messages use inconsistent prefixes, making production diagnostics fragile:

CURRENT STATE:
  status() line 95:  'connect to tailscaled socket: {e}'
  whois() line 166:  'connect: {e}'
  status() line 101: 'HTTP/1.1 handshake: {e}'
  whois() line 172:  'handshake: {e}'
  status() line 114: 'build request: {e}'
  whois() line 186:  'build request: {e}'

RISK: Operations logs won't have uniform diagnostic format. If someone fixes error messaging in one method without the other, drift increases.

ISSUE: A solo maintainer adding new error cases might not notice the inconsistency.

SUGGESTION: Define constants for error prefixes or a helper fn to ensure all socket operations, handshakes, and request builds report errors consistently across both methods.
